# Data and packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(BGLR)
library(kernlab)

SNPs <- as.matrix(read.table("gen.txt"))
SNPs <- t(SNPs)
```

# GBLUP

```{r}
library(AGHmatrix)

Kmat <- Gmatrix(SNPmatrix = SNPs, method = "VanRaden")
```

## 8

```{r}
y <- read.table("fen.txt") %>% pull(V1)
n <- length(y)

set.seed(123) 
folds <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = n))

acc_folds <- numeric(5)
predict_list <- list()

for (f in 1:5) {
  cat("\n Fold Processing", f, "\n")
  
  idx_test  <- which(folds == f)

  y_na <- y
  y_na[idx_test] <- NA
  
  ETA <- list(list(K = Kmat, model = "RKHS"))
  
  fit <- BGLR(
    y = y_na,
    ETA = ETA,
    nIter = 20000,   
    burnIn = 5000, 
    thin = 10,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  yhat_test <- fit$yHat[idx_test]
  
  acc_folds[f] <- cor(yhat_test, y[idx_test], use = "complete.obs")
  
  predict_list[[f]] <- data.frame(
    Fold = f,
    Genotype = idx_test,
    Observed = y[idx_test],
    Predicted = yhat_test
  )
}

final_results <- do.call(rbind, predict_list)
final_results

results <- data.frame(
  Model = "GBLUP",
  Mean_Accuracy = mean(acc_folds),
  SD_Accuracy = sd(acc_folds)
)

results

writexl::write_xlsx(results, "8GBLUP.xlsx")
```

# Laplacian

```{r}
Kmat0.001 <- kernelMatrix(laplacedot(sigma = 0.001), SNPs)
Kmat0.01 <- kernelMatrix(laplacedot(sigma = 0.01), SNPs)
Kmat0.05 <- kernelMatrix(laplacedot(sigma = 0.05), SNPs)
Kmat0.1 <- kernelMatrix(laplacedot(sigma = 0.1), SNPs)

sg <- list(
  sigma0.1 = Kmat0.1,
  sigma0.05 = Kmat0.05,
  sigma0.01 = Kmat0.01,
  sigma0.001 = Kmat0.001
)
```

## 8

```{r}
y <- read.table("fen.txt") %>% pull(V1)
n <- length(y)

set.seed(123)
folds <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = n))

results <- data.frame()
predicoes  <- list()

for (name_Model in names(sg)) {
  
  cat("\nProcessando Model:", name_Model, "\n")
  
  Kmat <- sg[[name_Model]]
  
  acc_folds <- numeric(5)
  predict_list <- list()
  
  for (f in 1:5) {
    
    cat("  Fold", f, "\n")
    
    idx_test <- which(folds == f)
    
    y_na <- y
    y_na[idx_test] <- NA
    
    ETA <- list(list(K = Kmat, model = "RKHS"))
    
    fit <- BGLR(
      y = y_na,
      ETA = ETA,
      nIter = 20000,
      burnIn = 5000,
      thin = 10,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    yhat_test <- fit$yHat[idx_test]
    
    acc_folds[f] <- cor(yhat_test, y[idx_test], use = "complete.obs")
    
    predict_list[[f]] <- data.frame(
      Model    = name_Model,
      Fold      = f,
      Genotype = idx_test,
      Observed = y[idx_test],
      Predicted   = yhat_test
    )
  }
  
  predicoes[[name_Model]] <- do.call(rbind, predict_list)
  
  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      Model         = name_Model,
      Mean_Accuracy = mean(acc_folds),
      SD_Accuracy    = sd(acc_folds)
    )
  )
}

results <- results[order(-results$Mean_Accuracy), ]

print(results)

writexl::write_xlsx(results, "8LPC.xlsx")
```

# Bessel

```{r}
sg  <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1)
ord  <- c(0, 1, 2)
dg <- c(2, 3)

hyper <- list()

for (i in sg) {
  for (j in ord) {
    for (l in dg) {
      Kmat <- kernelMatrix(besseldot(sigma = i, 
                                     order = j, 
                                     degree = l), 
                           SNPs)
      hyper[[paste0("sigma", i, "order", j, "degree", l)]] <- Kmat
    }
  }
}
```

# Polynomial

```{r}
dg <- c(2, 3)
sc  <- c(0.5, 1, 2)
off <- c(0, 1, 2)

hyper <- list()

for (i in dg) {
  for (j in sc) {
    for (l in off) {
      Kmat <- kernelMatrix(polydot(degree = i, 
                                   scale = j, 
                                   offset = l), 
                           SNPs)
      hyper[[paste0("degree", i, "scale", j, "offset", l)]] <- Kmat
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
predicoes  <- list()

for (name_Model in names(sg)) {
  
  cat("\nProcessando Model:", name_Model, "\n")
  
  Kmat <- sg[[name_Model]]
  
  acc_folds <- numeric(5)
  predict_list <- list()
  
  for (f in 1:5) {
    
    cat("  Fold", f, "\n")
    
    idx_test <- which(folds == f)
    
    y_na <- y
    y_na[idx_test] <- NA
    
    ETA <- list(list(K = Kmat, model = "RKHS"))
    
    fit <- BGLR(
      y = y_na,
      ETA = ETA,
      nIter = 20000,
      burnIn = 5000,
      thin = 10,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    yhat_test <- fit$yHat[idx_test]
    
    acc_folds[f] <- cor(yhat_test, y[idx_test], use = "complete.obs")
    
    predict_list[[f]] <- data.frame(
      Model    = name_Model,
      Fold      = f,
      Genotype = idx_test,
      Observed = y[idx_test],
      Predicted   = yhat_test
    )
  }
  
  predicoes[[name_Model]] <- do.call(rbind, predict_list)
  
  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      Model         = name_Model,
      Mean_Accuracy = mean(acc_folds),
      SD_Accuracy    = sd(acc_folds)
    )
  )
}

results <- results[order(-results$Mean_Accuracy), ]

print(results)

writexl::write_xlsx(results, "240GAUSS.xlsx")
```

# Random Forest

```{r}
library(caret)
library(ranger)

Kmat <- as.data.frame(SNPs)

data <- read.table("fen.txt", header = FALSE)

results_list <- list()
folds_list <- list()

for (v in 1:6) {
  
  cat("Trait Running V", v, "\n")
  
  y <- data %>% pull(v)
  
  data <- Kmat %>%
    mutate(y = y)
  
  set.seed(123)
  
  Model <- train(
    y ~ .,
    data = data,
    method = "ranger",
    trControl = trainControl(
      method = "cv",
      number = 5,
    )
  )
  
  print(Model)
  
  predicoes_cv <- Model$pred
  
  cor_folds <- predicoes_cv %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(
      Accuracy = cor(pred, obs, use = "complete.obs"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Trait = paste0("V", v)
    )
  
  results_list[[v]] <- data.frame(
    Trait = paste0("V", v),
    Mean_Accuracy = mean(cor_folds$Accuracy),
    SD_Accuracy = sd(cor_folds$Accuracy)
  )
}

results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
print(results)

write_xlsx(results, "RF.xlsx")
```
